question: How far back does a 1-hour, 4-hour or session high/low remain eligible as a draw on liquidity -- what is the lookback window?
whyItMatters: CLAIM|TJR|20260727|009 enumerates the level classes (1H, 4H, session highs and lows) but states no lookback. Without one the candidate draw set is unbounded, so both the target rule (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|029) and the step-1 sweep detection (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|008) compute nothing. Also unresolved: whether daily and weekly levels are draws, and whether session OPENS are marked levels -- CLAIM|TJR|20260727|010 says session opens are marked first each day, but the enumeration in |009 omits them entirely.
